Your consultation determines which path fits your bone, bite, timeline, and budget. Here's the landscape before you walk in.
A single dental implant replaces one missing tooth without using the neighboring teeth for support.

A few things affect where you fall in that range: the type of implant (titanium vs. zirconia, standard vs. premium components), and whether your case needs extra prep work like a bone graft or sinus lift.
An implant bridge replaces multiple missing teeth by anchoring a custom bridge to dental implants instead of natural teeth.
Pricing depends on the number of implants and pontics involved, the materials used, and the complexity of the case.
Four to six implants, placed in one procedure, supporting a complete set of fixed teeth. Not removable. Not temporary.
The price shifts based on how many implants are placed, the type of prosthesis you choose, and whether your case needs prep work like bone grafts or extractions beforehand.
Your Dental Work Shouldn't Look & Feel Like Dental Work

Every implant case at Grand Mission starts with, CBCT imaging, a full evaluation of your bone and bite, and a clear written plan. Complete records. A clear diagnosis - because lasting implant treatment begins with understanding, not urgency. the complete picture
A full evaluation of your bone, bite, and goals with CBCT imaging, plus a clear treatment plan and exact fee before anything begins.
Your implant is placed using a digital surgical guide, with sedation available. Qualifying patients can leave with a temporary tooth the same day.
Once healed, your custom porcelain crown is fitted, designed before day one to match your smile and last for decades.
Every smile below started with a conversation, a full examination, and a plan built around that specific patient. No shortcuts. No assumptions.

From the moment you walk in, Grand Mission feels different. Calm, modern, and built with patients in mind - because your experience starts before you sit in the chair. Our team speaks English, Spanish, Vietnamese, Korean, and Arabic.
Is the dental implant procedure painful?

The procedure is done under local anaesthetic and sedation options are available, so you should not feel it. Some soreness and swelling during early healing is normal and manageable. Most patients tell us it was far easier than they expected.
Can I really get a new tooth in one day?
Sometimes, yes. Depending on your bone quality and overall health, a temporary tooth can be placed the same day as your implant. Your 3D scan at the consultation is what tells us whether you qualify.
What if I have been told I do not have enough bone?

Do not rule yourself out. Bone grafting, sinus lifts and alternative implant approaches make treatment possible for many patients who were told no elsewhere. A CBCT scan shows exactly what is possible in your case.

The implant post is designed as a lifetime replacement root. With healthy gums, daily care and regular checkups, implants can last decades. The crown on top may need maintenance over time, like any tooth.
When will I find out the cost of my treatment?

At your consultation, once the 3D scan shows what your case actually needs. You will receive a written quote covering the implant post, abutment and crown, plus any bone grafting or extractions, before anything begins.

Insurance often covers part of the treatment, such as the crown or an extraction. Our team verifies your benefits before treatment and walks you through the financing options, so you know your exact out of pocket cost before you commit to anything.
What is the process for getting financing?

We handle it at the consultation. Once your treatment plan is set, our team runs the application with you and brings back the monthly options it returns. Nothing is agreed until you have seen the numbers in writing.
Stop Working Around A Missing Tooth
Every month you wait, the bone under the gap keeps shrinking , which can make treatment more involved later. Find out exactly where you stand with a free full evaluation and 3D scan.
